tasks.title: Run all tests and verify they pass
tasks.description:
Execute the complete test suite using 'npm test' or 'npx vitest run' to verify all existing tests pass. The test files to validate are:
- src/App.test.tsx
- src/components/Button.test.tsx
- src/components/Display.test.tsx
- src/components/Calculator.test.tsx

Ensure all tests execute successfully with no failures.
acceptance_criteria: All test files execute without errors
No test failures or warnings reported
Test coverage report shows successful execution
